name: US Post Office Boxes, Private Mailboxes and Rural Delivery
description: Post office box spellings, private mailboxes (PMB), rural route and highway contract route addresses, and general delivery. Rural and highway contract routes report the route in ruralRoute (rr holds a rural route's number) and the box as secUnitType Box. Shapes follow USPS Publication 28 (a US government work, public domain); inputs are constructed for this corpus unless a case's source says otherwise.
